games.name: Dying2Parkour DEMO
games.desc:
Welcome to Dying2Parkour; an open-world parkour game where you evolve your movement skills to conquer the ever-expanding world! Master your parkour skills, discover hidden routes, and push your limits as you progress through a environment built for exploration and freedom.

Currently in its demo stage, Dying2Parkour offers a glimpse into what’s to come. Future updates will introduce new features such as skill trees, minigames, party systems, time trials, gears, and more, all designed to enhance the gameplay and make the game seem more alive.

Inspired by the Dying Light franchise, Dying2Parkour reimagines its core parkour mechanics into a new and standalone experience with its own style and identity.

games.name: The Intruder
games.desc:
You are alone in your house. Suddenly, the phone rings. The police department issues a warning that a criminal is on the loose. Unfortunately, the criminal has a new target: YOU. Check the cameras in your room to watch his every move. He can sometimes enter your room to look for you. Hide in the closet if he does and turn off the lights. Wait until the phone regains service.

Updates: Fixed lever bug in hospital chapter.

Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: B]
Skill-Checks: [PC: E, Gamepad: A] 
Objective: [PC: Q] 

Inspirations: The Mandela Catalogue and Five Nights at Freddy's (also a few other games)

🔺WARNING🔺: This game includes flashing lights, loud sounds, and jumpscares.
